capabilities: Insert blank lines so one Enter starts a new paragraph

Write line breaks with Shift+Enter in three styles (plain, two spaces,
)
Split a paragraph in the middle at the cursor
Toggle the mode from the status bar mark or a command
Leave lists, quotes, code, tables and other blocks on the default Enter
extras: Free, no account, no network requests. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff (manifest notice). After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat, which can be turned off in settings. Mobile is allowed but untested on real devices; Android IME behavior can make Enter fall back to the default.
intentEvidence: makes one Enter start a new paragraph in Obsidian, the way Word, Scrivener, Typora and Roam work
motivation: The README says the plugin makes Enter work "the way Word, Scrivener, Typora and Roam work".
problem: In plain Markdown a new paragraph needs a blank line, so writers must press Enter twice and remember where single line breaks render.
summary: Editor behavior plugin that makes one Enter start a new paragraph by inserting the needed blank line, with Shift+Enter for line breaks.
